confidence_notes: The exact AC Legends v3.0 package was fingerprinted. Five H-pattern gears, clutch-required move-off, required lift, no automatic cut/blip, required manual rev matching, and a round cockpit rim without wheel display or shift lights were observed. The real-car sources correct the package's dogleg to the Type 915 conventional H and establish clutch/double-declutch technique. The guided clutch channel cannot distinguish a driver's pedal from car-side intervention, so the clutchless simulator overrides remain medium confidence.
scope_notes: Single exact identity staged from one guided-verification drive.
historical_notes: The draft recorded game version 'unknown'. During review it was tied to '14923034': The same installed Steam library used for the drive has appmanifest_244210.acf buildid 14923034. Its LastUpdated value and the AC executable timestamps predate the 2026-08-22 observation, and SteamDB independently identifies 14923034 as the public Assetto Corsa branch build published 2024-07-03.
